basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old avid gamer and recent college grad based in Northern Virginia. I love diving into RPGs and have a newfound passion for game development. When I'm not gaming, I enjoy experimenting with new recipes and exploring local eateries. I work as a junior developer at a tech startup. Single and always looking to connect with fellow gamers. My typical online hours are evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, and I've been self-teaching game development using platforms like Unity and Roblox. My interest in the culinary world comes from working part-time in restaurants during college.
